amendments.rule: attempts of a held-out item without a completed response are not sent by either student; completed rows already in the ledger are kept; a refused attempt is never re-sent
amendments.reason: the provider's content filter refused the step-by-step (S) prompt of Vi-DROP 1467 (HTTP 400 content_policy_violation, Muse Spark 1.2, S-r1 and S-r2, 2026-11-03 15:06 +07) and once refused the S-r2 prompt of Vi-SQuAD 2629 (HTTP 400, code not logged, Muse Spark 1.3, 14:59 +07); about four refusals in ten minutes were followed by 403 user_blocked on both models
amendments.safeguards: the attempts of one item are never in flight together, so a refusal pauses the run before the item's next prompt is sent; remaining attempts are sent replicate by replicate (all B-r1, then B-r2, up to S-r3), which changes only when an attempt is sent; the provider's error code is logged from the error body; a new refusal pauses the run and no launch follows without the owner
amendments.scoring: not yet decided: before the analysis the owner chooses between scoring the held-out and refused attempts as no answer (the item stays, as chosen on 2026-11-03) and leaving the held-out items out of every policy of both students; the analysis fails closed until then
